skill.name: freshdesk-automation
skill.description: Automate Freshdesk ticket, contact, company, note, reply, and search workflows through an authenticated Rube MCP connection.
skill.summary: Manage Freshdesk support records and conversations through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The 109 command-execution alerts and three reconnaissance alerts are false positives caused by Markdown tool names and ordinary Freshdesk guidance. The external MCP endpoint is a real low-severity dependency, while third-party data access, consequential writes, and sender overrides require safeguards.

remediation.issue: Rube MCP can receive Freshdesk customer data and perform account actions.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the intermediary, verify its privacy terms, use least-privilege Freshdesk authorization, and restrict the connection to approved accounts.

remediation.issue: Mutating workflows do not require a final confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Preview target records, recipients, field changes, and batch size. Require explicit confirmation before writes, imports, public notes, or replies.

remediation.issue: Reply tools support sender and agent identity overrides.
remediation.suggestion: Require proof of delegated authority before setting from_email or user_id. Otherwise, use the authenticated agent identity.

content.value_statement: Manual Freshdesk updates slow support teams and increase data-entry errors. This skill guides ticket, contact, company, note, reply, and search operations through Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Create, view, and update Freshdesk tickets with requester, status, priority, assignment, tags, and custom fields.
List and search tickets by status, priority, requester, assignee, date, tags, and supported custom fields.
Send public replies, add private or public notes, list conversations, and edit existing notes.
Search and list contacts, and import contact records from CSV files.
Search, list, create, and update companies with domains, account details, and supported custom fields.
Resolve Freshdesk record IDs, apply pagination, and use current schemas discovered through Rube MCP.
limitations: The skill requires Rube MCP and an authenticated Freshdesk connection.
Ticket search returns at most 300 results, and contact search requires exact values.
Agent names cannot be resolved directly without IDs from ticket responses or administrator configuration.
Freshdesk data passes through a third-party MCP service, and write operations can affect customers.

use_cases.title: Manage Daily Ticket Queues
use_cases.description: Find assigned tickets, inspect details, update statuses, and prepare accurate customer replies.

use_cases.title: Review Support Operations
use_cases.description: Filter tickets by status, priority, date, or assignee to identify workload and escalation needs.

use_cases.title: Maintain Customer Records
use_cases.description: Search, import, create, and update contact or company records while preserving Freshdesk field requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Find Priority Tickets
prompt_templates.prompt: Find open high-priority Freshdesk tickets created since [date]. Show ticket IDs, subjects, requesters, assignees, and statuses. Do not change records.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a queue without making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Support Ticket
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Freshdesk ticket for [requester] with subject [subject], description [description], and priority [priority]. Show all fields and wait for confirmation before creation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create one ticket with verified details.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare and Send a Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Freshdesk ticket [ticket ID] and draft a reply addressing [issue]. Show recipients and sender identity, then wait for confirmation before sending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Respond to a customer with approval.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Contact and Company Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Find contacts matching [criteria], resolve their companies, and propose [changes]. Report duplicates, affected records, and batch size. Execute only after explicit approval.

output_examples.input: Find open urgent tickets assigned to agent 418 since 2026-07-01.
output_examples.output: Found 6 matching tickets. Results include ticket IDs, subjects, requester names, creation dates, and current assignees. No records were changed.

output_examples.input: Prepare a public reply for ticket 4821 explaining the replacement schedule.
output_examples.output: Prepared a reply for ticket 4821 with the requester and sender shown for review. The message is awaiting confirmation and has not been sent.

output_examples.input: Update Acme Corporation to the Enterprise tier and add acme.example as a domain.
output_examples.output: Located one matching company and prepared the tier and domain changes. The update is awaiting confirmation.

best_practices: Call the tool search first and use the current Freshdesk schemas returned by Rube MCP.
Resolve names and email addresses to record IDs before any write operation.
Preview targets, recipients, identity overrides, and changes before requesting explicit approval.
anti_patterns: Do not use list-all endpoints when a filtered ticket query can limit customer data exposure.
Do not send replies, publish notes, import contacts, or update records without reviewing the final scope.
Do not assume display names, custom-field prefixes, status values, or priority values match Freshdesk IDs.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires Rube MCP and an active Freshdesk connection established through the returned authentication flow.

faq.question: Can it create and update tickets?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports ticket creation, viewing, status changes, priority changes, assignment, tags, and supported custom fields.

faq.question: Can it reply to customers?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare and send public replies after you review the recipients, sender identity, content, and target ticket.

faq.question: Does it manage contacts and companies?
faq.answer: Yes. It can search and list contacts, import CSV contacts, and search, create, or update companies.

faq.question: What search limits apply?
faq.answer: Advanced ticket and contact searches support ten pages with 30 results each. Contact searches require exact values.

faq.question: Does Freshdesk data leave my account?
faq.answer: Requests pass through Rube MCP as a third-party intermediary. Review its privacy terms and use least-privilege Freshdesk access.
